paite: Jotham bel avaihawmpat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-guk vai ahawm a, anu min Jerushah, Zadok tanu ahi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Jotham / (2 Kum 15.32-38)
english: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerushah the daughter of Zadok.

paite: Apa Uzziah thilhih bangbang hih in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih zel hi. TOUPA tempul ah bel alut kei hi. Himahleh mite'n hoih loutak in ana hih gige uhi.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that his father Uzziah had done. However he didn’t enter into Yahweh’s temple. The people still acted corruptly.

paite: TOUPA' inn a kongkhak saknungzaw abawl a, huan, Ophel kulh tung ah inn tampi alam behlap lai hi.
english: He built the upper gate of Yahweh’s house, and he built much on the wall of Ophel.

paite: Huan Judah tanggam ah khuate abawl a, gamnuai ah inn thupi taktakte, insangte alam lai hi.
english: Moreover he built cities in the hill country of Judah, and in the forests he built fortresses and towers.

paite: Ammon suante'n kumpipa adou ua, azou hi. Huchi in Ammon suante'n huai kum in dangka talent zakhat leh huit buh puak singkhat leh barli buh puak singkhat apia uhi. Huchibang mah in Ammon suante'n akum nihna leh akum thumna ah leng apia uhi.
english: He also fought with the king of the children of Ammon, and prevailed against them. The children of Ammon gave him the same year one hundred talents of silver, ten thousand cors of wheat, and ten thousand cors of barley. The children of Ammon also gave that much to him in the second year, and in the third.

paite: Huchi in Jotham in TOUPA a Pathian ma a lampi hoih abawl ziak in ahong hatta hi.
english: So Jotham became mighty, because he ordered his ways before Yahweh his God.

paite: Jotham thilhih dangte agaldoute, a-omdante ngai dih, Israel leh Judah kumpite thugelhnabu ah gelh in a-om hi.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars and his ways, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

paite: Vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-guk vai ahawm hi.
english: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.

paite: Jotham bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmu a, David khopi ah avui uh; asik in atapa Ahaz in vai ahawmta hi.
english: Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in David’s city; and Ahaz his son reigned in his place.
